mail/pop3_session#

A POP3 session in the TRANSACTION state: listing, fetching and deleting messages.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let mailbox = session.mailbox();
let state = await mailbox.state();                    // STAT
let listing = await mailbox.messages();               // LIST and UIDL
for listing -> entry {
    let message = await mailbox.message(entry.number());   // RETR, parsed
    await mailbox.delete(entry.number());                   // DELE
}
await session.quit();                                 // deletions take effect

Description#

A POP3 session in the TRANSACTION state: listing, fetching and deleting messages.

The caller connects and authenticates, then hands the transport to PopSession. One command runs at a time. Deletions take effect at QUIT; PopDeleteReset undoes them before.
